417: func runtimeEventDraft(req runtimepkg.Request, event runtimepkg.Event) runcontrol.EventDraft {
418: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
419: 	lowerType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Type))
420: 	lowerKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Kind))
421: 	switch lowerType {
422: 	case "warning", "warn", "error":
423: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
424: 	case "artifact", "file":
425: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventArtifact
426: 	case "finding":
427: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventFinding
428: 	case "message", "text", "output", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text", "reasoning", "content", "delta":
429: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
430: 	default:
431: 		// Kind-based fallback: reasoning and message kinds should be visible as message, not coalesced progress.
432: 		switch lowerKind {
433: 		case "message", "reasoning", "assistant", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text":
434: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
435: 		case "tool", "tool_use", "tool_call", "tool_call_update":
436: 			// Tools stay as progress but with distinct payload so coalescing can distinguish.
437: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventProgress
438: 		}
439: 	}
440: 	payload := map[string]string{
441: 		"runtime_event_id": boundedSafe(event.ID),
442: 		"runtime_run_id":   boundedSafe(event.RunID),
443: 		"session_id":       boundedSafe(event.SessionID),
444: 		"type":             boundedSafe(event.Type),
445: 		"kind":             boundedSafe(event.Kind),
446: 	}
447: 	if lowerKind == "tool" || lowerKind == "tool_use" || lowerKind == "tool_call" || lowerKind == "tool_call_update" {
448: 		captureToolObservation(payload, event.Payload)
449: 	}
450: 	// Preserve safe observable payload fields into durable storage for observability.
451: 	// Deny sensitive keys and truncate values to runcontrol-safe limits.
452: 	// Flatten one level of nesting so tool/action names buried in maps are surfaced as top-level payload keys
453: 	// that the run timeline JS expects (payload.tool, payload.action, payload.title, etc.).
454: 	for key, value := range event.Payload {
455: 		if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
456: 			continue
457: 		}
458: 		normalized := strings.TrimSpace(key)
459: 		if normalized == "" || len(normalized) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(normalized, "\x00\r\n") {
460: 			continue
461: 		}
462: 		if normalized == "type" || normalized == "kind" {
463: 			continue
464: 		}
465: 		if nested, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
466: 			for subKey, subVal := range nested {
467: 				if isSensitivePayloadKey(subKey) {
468: 					continue
469: 				}
470: 				subNorm := strings.TrimSpace(subKey)
471: 				if subNorm == "" || len(subNorm) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(subNorm, "\x00\r\n") {
472: 					continue
473: 				}
474: 				if _, exists := payload[subNorm]; exists {
475: 					continue
476: 				}
477: 				// Promote common observable sub-keys; namespace the rest to avoid collisions.
478: 				promote := map[string]bool{"tool": true, "title": true, "detail": true, "text": true, "delta": true, "content": true, "message": true, "action": true, "state": true, "status": true, "native_type": true, "line": true}
479: 				targetKey := subNorm
480: 				if !promote[subNorm] {
481: 					targetKey = normalized + "_" + subNorm
482: 					if len(targetKey) > 128 {
483: 						continue
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				if _, exists := payload[targetKey]; exists {
487: 					continue
488: 				}
489: 				str := payloadValueString(subVal)
490: 				if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
491: 					continue
492: 				}
493: 				if len(payload) >= 30 {
494: 					break
495: 				}
496: 				payload[targetKey] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
497: 			}
498: 			// Also keep a compact stringified top-level for debugging if not promoted.
499: 			if len(payload) < 30 {
500: 				if _, exists := payload[normalized]; !exists {
501: 					str := payloadValueString(value)
502: 					if strings.TrimSpace(str) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(str, "[map omitted") {
503: 						payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
504: 					}
505: 				}
506: 			}
507: 			continue
508: 		}
509: 		str := payloadValueString(value)
510: 		if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
511: 			continue
512: 		}
513: 		if len(payload) >= 30 {
514: 			break
515: 		}
516: 		if _, exists := payload[normalized]; exists {
517: 			continue
518: 		}
519: 		payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
520: 	}
521: 	// Ensure the most useful display keys are always present even if nested.
522: 	for _, want := range []string{"tool", "action", "title", "detail", "text", "delta"} {
523: 		if _, ok := payload[want]; ok {
524: 			continue
525: 		}
526: 		if v := findNestedString(event.Payload, want); v != "" {
527: 			payload[want] = boundedPayloadValue(v)
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	omission := (*runcontrol.Omission)(nil)
531: 	if event.RawPresent || event.RawOmitted {
532: 		reason := firstSafeValue(event.RawOmissionReason, "runtime payload omitted by safe persistence policy")
533: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe(reason), Count: 1}
534: 	} else if len(event.Payload) > len(payload)-5 {
535: 		// Payload had more fields than we persisted (truncated/omitted keys) – record for diagnostics but don't hide persisted fields.
536: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe("runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields"), Count: 1}
537: 	}
538: 	return runcontrol.EventDraft{
539: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeRuntime,
540: 		Stage: boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]), Task: boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"])),
541: 		Kind: payload["kind"], Tool: payload["tool"], Action: payload["action"],
542: 		Reason: payload["reason"], Detail: firstSafeValue(payload["detail"], payload["title"]),
543: 		Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
544: 	}
545: }

547: func isSensitivePayloadKey(key string) bool {
548: 	lower := strings.ToLower(key)
549: 	for _, marker := range []string{"secret", "token", "password", "authorization", "cookie", "api_key", "apikey", "credential", "auth"} {
550: 		if strings.Contains(lower, marker) {
551: 			return true
552: 		}
553: 	}
554: 	return false
555: }
556: 
557: func findNestedString(payload map[string]any, want string) string {
558: 	for _, v := range payload {
559: 		if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
560: 			if s, ok := m[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
561: 				return s
562: 			}
563: 			// One more level deep (common for opencode part.state structures)
564: 			for _, inner := range m {
565: 				if innerMap, ok := inner.(map[string]any); ok {
566: 					if s, ok := innerMap[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
567: 						return s
568: 					}
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 		}
572: 	}
573: 	return ""
574: }
575: 
576: func payloadValueString(value any) string {
577: 	switch v := value.(type) {
578: 	case string:
579: 		return v
580: 	case []byte:
581: 		if len(v) == 0 {
582: 			return ""
583: 		}
584: 		return string(v)
585: 	case bool:
586: 		if v {
587: 			return "true"
588: 		}
589: 		return "false"
590: 	case int:
591: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
592: 	case int8:
593: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
594: 	case int16:
595: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
596: 	case int32:
597: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
598: 	case int64:
599: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
600: 	case uint, uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64:
601: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
602: 	case float32, float64:
603: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
604: 	case map[string]any, map[string]string, []any, []string:
605: 		// Encode structured values compactly.
606: 		encoded, err := jsonMarshalTruncated(v)
607: 		if err != nil {
608: 			return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
609: 		}
610: 		return encoded
611: 	default:
612: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
613: 	}
614: }
615: 
616: func jsonMarshalTruncated(v any) (string, error) {
617: 	encoded, err := json.Marshal(v)
618: 	if err != nil {
619: 		return "", err
620: 	}
621: 	return string(encoded), nil
622: }

624: func captureToolObservation(out map[string]string, payload map[string]any) {
625: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
626: 		"tool_call_id": {"tool_call_id", "toolCallId", "call_id", "callID"},
627: 		"tool_name":    {"tool_name", "toolName", "tool", "name"},
628: 		"tool_status":  {"tool_status", "status", "phase"},
629: 	} {
630: 		if value := findNestedPayloadValue(payload, aliases, 0); value != nil {
631: 			if text, ok := value.(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(text) != "" {
632: 				out[target] = boundedPayloadValue(text)
633: 			}
634: 		}
635: 	}
636: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
637: 		"tool_arguments": {"tool_arguments", "arguments", "args", "input", "parameters"},
638: 		"tool_result":    {"tool_result", "result", "output", "content"},
639: 		"tool_error":     {"tool_error", "error"},
640: 	} {
641: 		value := findNestedPayloadValue(payload, aliases, 0)
642: 		if value == nil {
643: 			continue
644: 		}
645: 		encoded, err := json.Marshal(redactObservableValue(value))
646: 		if err == nil && string(encoded) != "null" {
647: 			out[target] = boundedPayloadValue(string(encoded))
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if out["tool"] == "" {
651: 		out["tool"] = out["tool_name"]
652: 	}
653: }
654: 
655: func findNestedPayloadValue(value any, aliases []string, depth int) any {
656: 	if depth > 5 {
657: 		return nil
658: 	}
659: 	switch typed := value.(type) {
660: 	case map[string]any:
661: 		for _, key := range aliases {
662: 			if found, ok := typed[key]; ok && found != nil {
663: 				return found
664: 			}
665: 		}
666: 		keys := make([]string, 0, len(typed))
667: 		for key := range typed {
668: 			keys = append(keys, key)
669: 		}
670: 		sort.Strings(keys)
671: 		for _, key := range keys {
672: 			if found := findNestedPayloadValue(typed[key], aliases, depth+1); found != nil {
673: 				return found
674: 			}
675: 		}
676: 	case []any:
677: 		for _, item := range typed {

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
233: 		if err != nil {
234: 			return c, err
235: 		}
236: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
237: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
238: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
239: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
240: 		if err != nil {
241: 			return c, err
242: 		}
243: 		if req.Task != "" {
244: 			owned := false
245: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
246: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
247: 			}
248: 			if !owned {
249: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
253: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
254: 		if req.Task != "" {
255: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
256: 		}
257: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
258: 	case OperationQARecover:
259: 		c.Mutates = true
260: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
261: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
262: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
263: 		c.Mutates = true
264: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
265: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
266: 	case OperationFlow:
267: 		c.Runtime = true
268: 		c.Mutates = true
269: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
270: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
271: 	case OperationStage:
272: 		c.Runtime = true
273: 		c.Mutates = true
274: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
275: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
276: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
277: 		c.Runtime = true
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
281: 	case OperationReviewStart:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
285: 		if req.RestartReview {
286: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
287: 		}
288: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
289: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
290: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
291: 		if err != nil {
292: 			return c, err
293: 		}
294: 		c.Runtime = true
295: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
296: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
297: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
298: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
299: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
300: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
301: 		if req.ForceReview {
302: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
303: 		}
304: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
305: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
306: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
307: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = true
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
312: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
313: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
314: 		c.Mutates = true
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
316: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
317: 	default:
318: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
319: 	}
320: 	if req.Project != "" {
321: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
322: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
323: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
324: 		} else {
325: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
326: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
327: 		}
328: 	} else {
329: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
330: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
331: 	}
332: 	if c.Mutates {
333: 		if req.Project != "" {
334: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
335: 		} else {
336: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
337: 		}
338: 	} else {
339: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
340: 	}
341: 	if c.Runtime {
342: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
343: 	}
344: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
345: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
346: 	if err != nil {
347: 		return c, err
348: 	}
349: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
350: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
351: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
352: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
353: 	if err != nil {
354: 		return c, err
355: 	}
356: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
357: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
358: 	return c, nil
359: }

361: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
362: 	switch req.Kind {
363: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
364: 	default:
365: 		return nil
366: 	}
367: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Suite != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {

376: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
377: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
378: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
379: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
380: 	if err != nil {
381: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
382: 	}
383: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
384: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
385: 	}
386: 	req = prepared.Request
387: 	if emit == nil {
388: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
389: 	}
390: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
391: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
392: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
393: 	}
394: 	ss := u.sprintService()
395: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
396: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
397: 	switch req.Kind {
398: 	case OperationValidate:
399: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
400: 		switch {
401: 		case req.Study != "":
402: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
403: 		case req.Sprint != "":
404: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
405: 		default:
406: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
407: 		}
408: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
409: 		if err != nil {
410: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
411: 		}
412: 		result.Message = validation.Status
413: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
414: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
415: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
416: 		if err != nil {
417: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
418: 		}
419: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
420: 	case OperationPrompt:
421: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
422: 		if err != nil {
423: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
424: 		}
425: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
426: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
427: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
428: 		if err != nil {
429: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
430: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
431: 		}
432: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
433: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
434: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
435: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
436: 		if err != nil {
437: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
438: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
439: 		}
440: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
441: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
442: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
443: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
444: 		if err != nil {
445: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
446: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
447: 		}
448: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
449: 		result.Message = r.Message
450: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
451: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
454: 		}
455: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
456: 		if !execute.Available {
457: 			result.Message = execute.Message
458: 		} else {
459: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
460: 		}
461: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
462: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
463: 		if err != nil {
464: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
465: 		}
466: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
467: 		result.Message = r.Message
468: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
469: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
470: 		if err != nil {
471: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
472: 		}
473: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
474: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
480: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
481: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
482: 		if err != nil {
483: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
484: 		}
485: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
486: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
487: 	case OperationQAStatus:
488: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
489: 		if err != nil {
490: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
491: 		}
492: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
493: 	case OperationQADryRun:
494: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
495: 		if err != nil {
496: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
497: 		}
498: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
499: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
500: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
501: 	case OperationQARecover:
502: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
503: 		if err != nil {
504: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
505: 		}
506: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
507: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
508: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
509: 		if err != nil {
510: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
511: 		}
512: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
513: 	default:
514: 		if u.runner == nil {
515: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
516: 		}
517: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
518: 	}
519: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
520: 	return result, nil
521: }

541: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
542: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
543: 		if value == "" {
544: 			continue
545: 		}
546: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
547: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
548: 		}
549: 		for _, r := range value {
550: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
551: 				continue
552: 			}
553: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
554: 		}
555: 	}
556: 	return nil
557: }

559: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
560: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
561: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
562: 	for _, value := range values {
563: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
564: 		if value == "" {
565: 			continue
566: 		}
567: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
568: 			continue
569: 		}
570: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
571: 		out = append(out, value)
572: 	}
573: 	sort.Strings(out)
574: 	return out
575: }

663: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
664: 	hash := sha256.New()
665: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
666: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
667: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
668: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
669: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
670: 			continue
671: 		}
672: 		if err != nil {
673: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
674: 		}
675: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
676: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
677: 		}
678: 		if info.IsDir() {
679: 			var files []string
680: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
681: 				if walkErr != nil {
682: 					return walkErr
683: 				}
684: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
685: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
686: 				}
687: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
688: 					files = append(files, item)
689: 				}
690: 				return nil
691: 			}); err != nil {
692: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
693: 			}
694: 			sort.Strings(files)
695: 			for _, item := range files {
696: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
697: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
698: 					return "", err
699: 				}
700: 			}
701: 			continue
702: 		}
703: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
704: 			return "", err
705: 		}
706: 	}
707: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
708: }

714: 	}

716: 	_, _ = hash.Write(data)

886: 		result.Subject = ref
887: 		result.Status = string(validation.Status)
888: 		for _, finding := range validation.Findings {

890: 		}
891: 	case ValidationStudy:

893: 		validation, err := study.NewService(u.root).ValidateStudy(ref)

898: 		result.Status = string(validation.Status)
899: 		for _, check := range validation.Checks {
900: 			if check.Status != study.ValidationStatusPassed {
901: 				result.Findings = append(result.Findings, studyFinding(check))
902: 			}
903: 		}
904: 		for _, report := range validation.Reports {

914: 		if err != nil {
915: 			return result, mapSprintError("sprint.validate", err)
916: 		}
917: 		result.Subject = strings.TrimSpace(req.Project) + "/" + strings.TrimSpace(req.Sprint) + "/" + string(stage)
918: 		if !validation.Valid() {
919: 			result.Status = "invalid"
920: 		}
921: 		for _, finding := range validation.Findings {
922: 			result.Findings = append(result.Findings, sprintFinding(finding))
923: 		}
924: 	default:
925: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("validate: unsupported subject %q", req.Subject)
926: 	}
927: 	sort.SliceStable(result.Findings, func(i, j int) bool {
928: 		a, b := result.Findings[i], result.Findings[j]
929: 		if a.Path != b.Path {
930: 			return a.Path < b.Path
931: 		}
932: 		if a.Section != b.Section {
933: 			return a.Section < b.Section
934: 		}
935: 		return a.Problem < b.Problem
936: 	})
937: 	return result, nil
938: }

242: 		}
243: 		if req.Task != "" {
244: 			owned := false
245: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
246: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
247: 			}
248: 			if !owned {
249: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
253: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
254: 		if req.Task != "" {
255: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
256: 		}
257: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
258: 	case OperationQARecover:
259: 		c.Mutates = true
260: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
261: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
262: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
263: 		c.Mutates = true
264: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
265: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
266: 	case OperationFlow:
267: 		c.Runtime = true
268: 		c.Mutates = true
269: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
270: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
271: 	case OperationStage:
272: 		c.Runtime = true
273: 		c.Mutates = true
274: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
275: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
276: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
277: 		c.Runtime = true
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
281: 	case OperationReviewStart:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
285: 		if req.RestartReview {
286: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
287: 		}
288: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
289: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
290: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
291: 		if err != nil {
292: 			return c, err
293: 		}
294: 		c.Runtime = true
295: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
296: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
297: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
298: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
299: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
300: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
301: 		if req.ForceReview {
302: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
303: 		}
304: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
305: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
306: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
307: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = true
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
312: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
313: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
314: 		c.Mutates = true
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
316: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
317: 	default:
318: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
319: 	}
320: 	if req.Project != "" {
321: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
322: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
323: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint

326: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project

328: 	} else {

331: 	}

338: 	} else {

341: 	if c.Runtime {

345: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)

352: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)

355: 	}

376: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
377: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
378: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
379: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
380: 	if err != nil {
381: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
382: 	}
383: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
384: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
385: 	}
386: 	req = prepared.Request
387: 	if emit == nil {
388: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
389: 	}
390: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
391: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
392: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
393: 	}
394: 	ss := u.sprintService()
395: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
396: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
397: 	switch req.Kind {
398: 	case OperationValidate:
399: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
400: 		switch {
401: 		case req.Study != "":
402: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
403: 		case req.Sprint != "":
404: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
405: 		default:
406: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
407: 		}
408: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
409: 		if err != nil {
410: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
411: 		}
412: 		result.Message = validation.Status
413: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
414: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
415: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
416: 		if err != nil {
417: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
418: 		}
419: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
420: 	case OperationPrompt:
421: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
422: 		if err != nil {
423: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
424: 		}
425: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
426: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
427: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
428: 		if err != nil {
429: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
430: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
431: 		}
432: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
433: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
434: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
435: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
436: 		if err != nil {
437: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
438: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
439: 		}
440: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
441: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
442: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
443: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
444: 		if err != nil {
445: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
446: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
447: 		}
448: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
449: 		result.Message = r.Message
450: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
451: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
454: 		}
455: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
456: 		if !execute.Available {
457: 			result.Message = execute.Message
458: 		} else {
459: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
460: 		}
461: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
462: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
463: 		if err != nil {
464: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
465: 		}
466: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
467: 		result.Message = r.Message
468: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
469: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
470: 		if err != nil {
471: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
472: 		}
473: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
474: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
480: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
481: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
482: 		if err != nil {
483: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
484: 		}
485: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
486: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
487: 	case OperationQAStatus:
488: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
489: 		if err != nil {
490: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
491: 		}
492: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
493: 	case OperationQADryRun:
494: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
495: 		if err != nil {
496: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
497: 		}
498: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
499: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
500: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
501: 	case OperationQARecover:
502: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
503: 		if err != nil {
504: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
505: 		}
506: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
507: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
508: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
509: 		if err != nil {
510: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
511: 		}
512: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
513: 	default:
514: 		if u.runner == nil {
515: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
516: 		}
517: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
518: 	}
519: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
520: 	return result, nil
521: }

541: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
542: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
543: 		if value == "" {
544: 			continue
545: 		}
546: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
547: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
548: 		}
549: 		for _, r := range value {
550: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
551: 				continue
552: 			}
553: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
554: 		}
555: 	}
556: 	return nil
557: }

559: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
560: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
561: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
562: 	for _, value := range values {
563: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
564: 		if value == "" {
565: 			continue
566: 		}
567: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
568: 			continue
569: 		}
570: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
571: 		out = append(out, value)
572: 	}
573: 	sort.Strings(out)
574: 	return out
575: }

663: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
664: 	hash := sha256.New()
665: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
666: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
667: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
668: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
669: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
670: 			continue
671: 		}
672: 		if err != nil {
673: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
674: 		}
675: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
676: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
677: 		}
678: 		if info.IsDir() {
679: 			var files []string
680: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
681: 				if walkErr != nil {
682: 					return walkErr
683: 				}
684: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
685: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
686: 				}
687: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
688: 					files = append(files, item)
689: 				}
690: 				return nil
691: 			}); err != nil {

# Context Pack: `durable-operation-spine` — App durable operation spine

Target: ultraplan-go @ 50d6f0d25ff273f4cb956f11e6030376108110bc (working tree clean except untracked `.ultraplan/`).

Domain: durability-core. Risk: critical. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
`newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).

### 2.2 Outer accept — `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:97-138)
Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.

### 2.3 QA writer-token handoff (`qaOwnershipFromContext` :140-156)
Extracts `durableOperationOwnership` from ctx; builds `sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID, OperationalAttemptID, FencingGeneration}` (sprint/qa_types.go:179-191) plus a fence closure: full struct equality against the minted token else `ErrStaleFence` (:147-149); on match performs `repository.Heartbeat(context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s), fence, 15s lease)` (:150-153) — heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes. Sprint side: `checkWriter` requires a configured fence before every QA publish (sprint/qa_state.go:453-465); without an installed fence sprint falls back to comparing against `req.WriterToken` (sprint/qa.go:260-267).

### 2.4 Event recording + coalescing (`RecordOperationEvent` :158-221)
Adapter emit callbacks call this with `context.Background()`. Unknown RunID → `(false, ErrNotFound)` (:162-164). Per-operation `eventMu` serializes: event type = progress, or warning when `State==OperationFailed` (:167-170); dedup key = concatenation of type/stage/task/phase-state/summary/event-type/kind/tool/reason/detail (:171); identical progress within `ProgressCoalesceWindow`=250 ms (measured against wall-clock `time.Now().UTC()`) increments an in-memory omission counter instead of appending (:174-181, returns `(false,nil)` so adapters ALSO suppress local display). Non-coalesced events build payload {state,type,count "done/total"} plus optional phase_state/summary/tool_*/provider/model/harness keys when non-empty (:182-195); pending coalesced count flushes into the draft's Omission metadata (:196-207); append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; append error calls `owned.cancel()` and returns the error (:208-216); progress bookkeeping updated only after commit (:217-219).

1 s ticker (`OwnerTickInterval`, model.go:514): Snapshot poll (:235) — error ⇒ cancel+exit silently (:236-239); `CancellationRequested` ⇒ fenced `AcknowledgeCancellation` then cancel (:240-247); heartbeat every ≥5 s (`HeartbeatInterval`) (:248-254); `Reconcile` every ≥10 s (`ReconciliationInterval`) (:255-261). Any of these errors cancels and exits WITHOUT surfacing or persisting a diagnostic. Exit conditions: ctx done, `owned.stop` closed, or first tick error. `FinishOperation` joins via `owned.done`.

### 2.6 Finish + terminal mapping (`FinishOperation` :266-300)
Pops ownership under mutex (unknown id ⇒ nil, no-op success :267-273). Under `eventMu`: flush trailing coalesced omissions as an omission event; a flush failure becomes `runErr` only when no other error exists (:274-282). Then close(stop) → wait done → owned.cancel() (:283-285). Outcome mapping order (:286-297): `errors.Is(runErr, DeadlineExceeded)` → timed_out; `errors.Is(runErr, Canceled)` OR `state==cancelled` → cancelled; other `runErr != nil` OR `state==failed` → failed; `state==partial` → interrupted; default succeeded. Pinned by source-inventory test (§10).

### 2.8 Inner runtime runs — `controlledRuntime.StartRun` (run_control.go:159-343)

## 5. Invariants (as implemented)

- Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).
- Persistence-gated delivery: display/downstream callbacks fire only after the corresponding Append commits, in both spine variants (run_control.go:246-248; web publishAppEvent; TUI emit gating).
- One claim per run lifetime, one terminal winner, monotonic sequences: inherited from runcontrol CAS/fencing (dependency surface); this surface always operates through freshly minted per-attempt fences and never mutates rows directly.
- Fail-closed on persistence loss: mid-run append/heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure cancels the run context (work drains through cancellation) and ends in a `persistence_lost` terminal proposed on a detached context; start-time append failure terminalizes before returning.
- Coalescing never loses counts: collapsed duplicates accumulate into Omission {reason, count, first/last} carried by the next committed event or flushed at finish; committed=false also suppresses duplicate local display.
- Cancellation path: external request persisted (ownerless) → observed within ≤1 s tick → fenced AcknowledgeCancellation → local context cancel → product drains → terminal arbitration decides cancelled-vs-completed with single-winner guarantee.
- Detached-terminal discipline: every finish/terminal/QA-heartbeat write uses a fresh ≤30 s background context (`context.Background()`/`WithoutCancel`), so shutdown or run-context cancellation cannot prevent terminal commit; append retries are strictly 5 s-bounded.
- Single process owner: all claims of one process share Owner.ID; fencing generations distinguish attempts.
- Boundedness at the boundary: target fields ≤512 B, payload values ≤32 KiB, payload ≤30 entries, keys ≤128 B, control bytes stripped before storage validation sees them.
- Structural pinning: runtime-backed CLI entries must cross `beginDurableCLICommand` (inventory test, §10); TUI/web must go through `DurableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (capability interface assertion pattern).

## 6. Trust boundaries

- Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). Confirmation tokens consumed once server-side (web preparation store); dedup keys derived server-side from session+token (security.go:448-451). The digest persisted into `operation_aliases`/`confirmation_digest` is always the server-computed hash, never raw transport data.
- Runtime/provider events → durable store: untrusted maps pass the app-side pipeline (denylist keys, redaction markers, bounds, flattening caps, §2.9) AND the runcontrol storage sanitizer; dropped detail becomes Omission metadata, never silence.
- Context-carried capability: `durableOperationOwnership` (repository + fence) travels in context values; QA token equality (struct compare incl. generation) is the only check that a caller presenting a token owns the fence; possession of the ctx (or token) IS the authority.
- Workspace-local trust domain: any local process may open the same db and accept/claim/cancel; no authorization layer between adapters and repository (inherited posture from dependency surface).
- Child-process boundary: `run_control_run_id` metadata injection clones the caller's metadata map before mutation (run_control.go:186-187); prompt content itself is never persisted here (test-pinned "never persisted").

## 7. External effects & cancellation/retry/restart/error semantics

Effects: runcontrol db rows/WAL via shared pool; child runtime execution (network sessions, provider APIs — owned by platform/runtime surfaces); sprint/study/QA workspace file mutations triggered by product code running INSIDE accepted contexts; stdout/stderr presentation. No direct filesystem writes by this layer beyond what repository/logger do.

Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Claim failure after successful Accept leaves an accepted-unclaimed row for reconciliation (grace 45 s — dependency surface). Start-append failure ⇒ persistence_lost terminal, start aborts. Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure ⇒ same cancel path (manager variant silent; runtime variant recorded). Retry posture: appends ≤5 s on Unavailable/Busy; terminals effectively until 30 s ctx expiry. Restart/crash: abandoned outer runs keep leases expiring at 15 s; reconciliation (startup + periodic, dependency surface) terminalizes them interrupted/uncertain using birth identity; restarted work is a NEW run correlated by ParentRun/ProductRunID, never adopted. Shutdown: process Close() closes pools last; all terminal proposals ride detached contexts; web drain records cleanup-uncertain via separate capability (web_usecases.go:540-561 — adjacent seam).

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. - Durable authority is `.ultraplan/run-control.db` (schema/ownership: surface `run-journal-fencing`). ## 5. Invariants (as implemented)

- Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).
- Persistence-gated delivery: display/downstream callbacks fire only after the corresponding Append commits, in both spine variants (run_control.go:246-248; web publishAppEvent; TUI emit gating).
- One claim per run lifetime, one terminal winner, monotonic sequences: inherited from runcontrol CAS/fencing (dependency surface); this surface always operates through freshly minted per-attempt fences and never mutates rows directly.
- Fail-closed on persistence loss: mid-run append/heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure cancels the run context (work drains through cancellation) and ends in a `persistence_lost` terminal proposed on a detached context; start-time append failure terminalizes before returning.
- Coalescing never loses counts: collapsed duplicates accumulate into Omission {reason, count, first/last} carried by the next committed event or flushed at finish; committed=false also suppresses duplicate local display.
- Cancellation path: external request persisted (ownerless) → observed within ≤1 s tick → fenced AcknowledgeCancellation → local context cancel → product drains → terminal arbitration decides cancelled-vs-completed with single-winner guarantee.
- Detached-terminal discipline: every finish/terminal/QA-heartbeat write uses a fresh ≤30 s background context (`context.Background()`/`WithoutCancel`), so shutdown or run-context cancellation cannot prevent terminal commit; append retries are strictly 5 s-bounded.
- Single process owner: all claims of one process share Owner.ID; fencing generations distinguish attempts.
- Boundedness at the boundary: target fields ≤512 B, payload values ≤32 KiB, payload ≤30 entries, keys ≤128 B, control bytes stripped before storage validation sees them.
- Structural pinning: runtime-backed CLI entries must cross `beginDurableCLICommand` (inventory test, §10); TUI/web must go through `DurableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (capability interface assertion pattern).

## 6. Trust boundaries

- Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). Confirmation tokens consumed once server-side (web preparation store); dedup keys derived server-side from session+token (security.go:448-451). The digest persisted into `operation_aliases`/`confirmation_digest` is always the server-computed hash, never raw transport data.
- Runtime/provider events → durable store: untrusted maps pass the app-side pipeline (denylist keys, redaction markers, bounds, flattening caps, §2.9) AND the runcontrol storage sanitizer; dropped detail becomes Omission metadata, never silence.
- Context-carried capability: `durableOperationOwnership` (repository + fence) travels in context values; QA token equality (struct compare incl. generation) is the only check that a caller presenting a token owns the fence; possession of the ctx (or token) IS the authority.
- Workspace-local trust domain: any local process may open the same db and accept/claim/cancel; no authorization layer between adapters and repository (inherited posture from dependency surface).
- Child-process boundary: `run_control_run_id` metadata injection clones the caller's metadata map before mutation (run_control.go:186-187); prompt content itself is never persisted here (test-pinned "never persisted").

## 7. External effects & cancellation/retry/restart/error semantics

Effects: runcontrol db rows/WAL via shared pool; child runtime execution (network sessions, provider APIs — owned by platform/runtime surfaces); sprint/study/QA workspace file mutations triggered by product code running INSIDE accepted contexts; stdout/stderr presentation. No direct filesystem writes by this layer beyond what repository/logger do.

Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Claim failure after successful Accept leaves an accepted-unclaimed row for reconciliation (grace 45 s — dependency surface). Start-append failure ⇒ persistence_lost terminal, start aborts. Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure ⇒ same cancel path (manager variant silent; runtime variant recorded). Retry posture: appends ≤5 s on Unavailable/Busy; terminals effectively until 30 s ctx expiry. Restart/crash: abandoned outer runs keep leases expiring at 15 s; reconciliation (startup + periodic, dependency surface) terminalizes them interrupted/uncertain using birth identity; restarted work is a NEW run correlated by ParentRun/ProductRunID, never adopted. Shutdown: process Close() closes pools last; all terminal proposals ride detached contexts; web drain records cleanup-uncertain via separate capability (web_usecases.go:540-561 — adjacent seam).

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
`newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).

Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.
